title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ（津田敏宏研究室）
subtitle: Design Project III(Tsuda Toshihiro)
educationalGoal:
The subject of this course is a basic study on rotating machines, which is useful for solving environmental and energy issues.
Through the study, students will:
(1) learn how to find technical challenges and solve them.
(2) learn how to compile technical reports and give their presentations.
advice:
In this course, we will cover the following topics:
1. Design and analysis of rotating machines.
2. Development of a new type of rotating machine.

Students are required to actively participate in class.
requiredKnowledge: Knowledge of electromagnetics and electric circuits.

activityGoals.body: Be able to clearly define the goal of the study and to create a plan for achieving it.
Be able to communicate well with group members and to pursue the study.
Be able to solve technical challenges in the study by yourself.
Be able to compile results of the study as a final report (i.e., project report).
Be able to make presentations about results of the study effectively.

              The subject of this course is a basic study on rotating machines, which is useful for solving environmental and energy issues.
Through the study, students will:
(1) learn how to find technical challenges and solve them.
(2) learn how to compile technical reports and give their presentations.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              In this course, we will cover the following topics:
1. Design and analysis of rotating machines.
2. Development of a new type of rotating machine.

Students are required to actively participate in class.
